services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: When dealing with unpredictable tides and seasonal fish patterns in Mount Pleasant, working with a guide who knows the marsh creeks, oyster beds, and grass flats makes the difference between a slow morning and a full cooler. Inshore waters around Mount Pleasant hold red drum, speckled trout, flounder, sheepshead, and redfish year-round, but each species moves with temperature, bait migration, and moon phase. A full-service charter handles the scouting, positioning, and bait selection so you spend your time casting instead of guessing. services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Sunset cruises in Charleston, SC offer scenic 2-hour trips showcasing beautiful views of Charleston Harbor and surrounding islands, ideal for romantic evenings or relaxed family outings on the water. Sunset cruises deliver unobstructed views of Charleston's historic skyline and barrier islands as natural light transforms the harbor into vibrant shades of gold and pink. You glide past iconic landmarks including Fort Sumter, the Ravenel Bridge, and the historic Battery while the setting sun casts long shadows across the water.
